title: Changelog
desc: Dated record of shipped behavior changes.
lede: A running record of shipped changes. The 2.0 line is summarized here; the full history lives with the project.
body:
At a glance
  • 2.0 highlights collected here.
  • Patch lines noted as they ship.
  • Full history in the repository.

2.0 highlights

  • Managed TTS Server + watchdog.
  • Task orchestrator, predictive progress, recovery.
  • Plugin SDK, external TTS API, composite synthesis.
  • Voice tags & icons; clearer first-run model-download progress.

Recent patch lines

Patch-level changes are recorded as they ship.

Note — The authoritative, dated changelog is maintained in the repository and release notes.
